answer: An agent economy can bind voting weight to a scarce, nontransferable work credential: each agent must complete a randomly assigned task, with its result checked against hidden test cases before it earns one credential. Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same proof, and credentials expire, so a sybil operator must continually spend compute and human effort to create fresh, valid work. An island of honest agents can also audit a sparrow’s result by following its thread of task and verification records.
